messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text: <@1166065212537970722> found it. the distribution fix only counts part of your buildings once your nation is big, and the page was showing the full amount. that's why it looked fine while people starved. fixed now: no starvation until Oct 19, the page shows the real coverage, and it's 4x gentler after that. details: https://discord.com/channels/708006319658893385/1448838647766847489/1559562591552934053
